name: Automotive — Multi-Agent MCP Orchestration
description: A multi-agent orchestrator coordinates sub-agents over MCP across a European automaker's Snowflake data mesh, Dataiku environment, and Oracle financial systems. AIControl intercepts every tool call before execution — the tool names and parameters below are illustrative constructions modeling that kind of architecture, not any specific vendor's actual internal API.
incident_headline: This org's stated governance principle: agents are not allowed to operate autonomously, and every action must trace back to a registered semantic model and an AI-Act compliance catalog entry. This session shows what happens when an orchestration step tries to cross those lines.
closing_line: No autonomous agents, full AI Act traceability — that's the governance principle. AIControl is how it survives contact with an actual MCP tool call.

steps.label: Query the sales-analytics data product for the FR market
steps.narrative: The orchestrator's data-mesh sub-agent queries a data product it owns, within its own domain. In scope. Allow.

decision_narratives.allow: Authorized read, scoped to the agent's own data-mesh domain. Logged.

steps.label: Query the Oracle warranty-reserve ledger via MCP
steps.narrative: Via MCP, the orchestration reaches out of the data mesh into Oracle — a financial system outside its normal domain. This org's own governance principle says agents don't cross a system boundary like this unattended.

decision_narratives.review: Routed to a human domain owner via Slack — the agent is stepping outside its data-mesh domain into a financial system.

steps.label: Invoke a sub-agent with no registered semantic model or AI Act catalog entry
steps.narrative: An agent-to-agent MCP call targets a sub-agent that isn't registered in the org's semantic-model / AI Act model catalog — exactly the traceability gap its own compliance roadmap calls out.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. The call never reached the sub-agent — this is your evidence trail that an uncataloged agent-to-agent call was attempted and stopped.
